## Flagship Systems
- **llm-devops** (`https://github.com/Yash55-max/llm-devops`): Self-serve LLM inference platform on AWS EKS (v1.35) provisioned with modular Terraform, private multi-AZ subnets, ALB Ingress, NAT Gateway, least-privilege IRSA (`ebs-csi-irsa`), ArgoCD GitOps, and kube-prometheus-stack observability.
- **ClearLedger** (`https://clear-ledger-chi.vercel.app` | `https://github.com/Yash55-max/ClearLedger`): Accounts Payable reconciliation platform pairing deterministic ledger matching with LangGraph/Gemini AI audit commentary.
- **BugShot** (`https://github.com/Yash55-max/BugShot`): Published Manifest V3 browser extension for capturing, annotating, and filing visual bug reports directly to GitHub Issues.
- **rag-api** (`https://github.com/Yash55-max/rag-api`): Async FastAPI vector retrieval API powered by ChromaDB and local Ollama inference (~42ms p95 local lab benchmark).
- **Multi-Agent ADK** (`https://github.com/Yash55-max/multi-agent-adk`): Python AsyncIO coordinator-worker multi-agent orchestration framework.
